description: Shape every Stage 19 benchmark/soak report's `environment` field must match. Consumed by scripts/performance/lib/environment-fingerprint parsing helpers and enforced by tests/performance/stage19/unit/environment-fingerprint.test.js. Never include username, hostname, IP address, credential, secret env value, token, or any private filesystem path here — see the `forbiddenFields` list.

containerResourceLimits.description: Per-service deploy.resources.limits, read directly from infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml so this can never drift from the real lab.

notes: startedAt is the wall-clock ISO-8601 timestamp the benchmark/soak run began, not the container start time.

filesystemType is the best-effort mount filesystem (e.g. ext4, overlay, tmpfs) backing the repo working directory, read from /proc/mounts or `df -T` output; falls back to "unknown" rather than failing the run.
openobserveVersion/openobserveImageDigest are read from infrastructure/docker/images.lock.json, never queried from a running container, so they stay accurate even when the lab is down.
